brief:
Settlers stole approximately 300 sheep and a horse belonging to farmer Youssef Fawaz Awwada from the Hayyan area in Deir Dibwan east of Ramallah, the Ma'an news agency reported. The theft marks another incident of livestock loss in the area, where Palestinian farmers have faced repeated confiscation of animals by settlers.

No further details on the timing of the theft or recovery efforts were immediately available.
title: Settlers steal 300 sheep and horse from Palestinian farmer east of Ramallah
